evidence.title: GitHub - BradGroux/veritas-kanban: Lightweight orchestration harness built for your AI agents.

name: Veritas Kanban
summary: Local-first Kanban board with optional AI agent orchestration: CLI, MCP server, workflows and governance.
description: A local-first task board: start with the Kanban UI and Markdown tasks on disk, then add a CLI, an MCP server, multi-agent orchestration, a YAML workflow engine, approval gates and policy governance. The board ships customizable dashboard widgets, telemetry, an evidence timeline and time breakdowns; agents run as first-class workers (Codex, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Ollama …) on web, Electron desktop for macOS and REST API. MIT licensed.
contains: Kanban board with drag-and-drop columns, subtasks, dependencies and sprints
optional layers: CLI, MCP server, OpenClaw, webhooks, workflows, governance
multi-agent orchestration with dashboard, squad chat and team roster routing
YAML workflow engine with run state and approval gates
customizable dashboard widgets, telemetry, evidence timeline, time breakdowns
agent providers: Codex, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and Ollama/LM Studio
packaged macOS desktop app plus self-hosted server
